CRITICAL: The backend server is ALREADY RUNNING at http://localhost:3002 with the latest code changes.

Auth credentials:
- Admin: username=jose, password=Password1 (role: admin)
- Standard user: username=alix, password=Password1 (role: user)

Login: POST /api/auth/login with JSON body {"username":"...","password":"..."} returns {"token":"...","user":{...}}. Use token as Bearer in Authorization header.

Rate limiter: 10 requests per 15 seconds per IP. Add 2-second delays between requests.

To get valid itemId: GET /api/items returns {"items":[...]} — use id from first item.

Stock position: GET /api/transactions/stock-position returns {"positions":[...]} with adelQty, calhounQty per item.

Adjustment endpoint: POST /api/transactions/adjustments expects JSON body:
{"itemId": number, "location": "ADEL", "quantity": number, "reason": "Damage"|"Shrinkage"|"Correction"|"Other", "notes": "optional"}
Note: "Cycle Count" is NOT a valid reason anymore.

Transfer endpoint: POST /api/transactions/transfers expects JSON body:
{"itemId": number, "fromLocation": "ADEL", "toLocation": "CALHOUN", "quantity": number}

Item deactivation: PATCH /api/items/:id/status with body {"isActive": false}
Item creation: POST /api/items with body {"itemCode":"...", "description":"...", "category":"...", "unitOfMeasure":"EA"}

BOM endpoints:
- GET /api/boms (list all BOMs)
- GET /api/boms/:id (single BOM with components)
- PATCH /api/boms/:id/status with body {"status":"RETIRED"|"ACTIVE"}

Kitting: POST /api/production/kit expects JSON body:
{"finishedGoodId": number, "location": "ADEL", "quantityProduced": 1, "bomId": number, "components": [{"itemId": number, "quantityPer": number}, ...]}

These 6 tests validate hardening fixes from a scenario audit:
1. TC001-TC002: Adjustment guardrails (stock floor, reason validation)
2. TC003-TC004: Item deactivation with stock check
3. TC005: Transfer race condition fix (serializable transaction)
4. TC006: Retired BOM blocked from kitting
